questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] What type of bond involves the sharing of electron pairs between atoms?
A. Ionic bond
B. Hydrogen bond
C. Covalent bond
Answer: C. Covalent bonds, where atoms share electron pairs, form the basis of molecular structures in a vast array of substances, from simple molecules like water to complex organic compounds.
questions.de: Welche Art chemischer Bindung beruht darauf, dass Atome Elektronenpaare teilen?
questions.en: What type of chemical bond involves the sharing of electron pairs between atoms?

timeline.labelEn: Gilbert N. Lewis describes the sharing of electron pairs between atoms
timeline.labelDe: Gilbert N. Lewis beschreibt das Teilen von Elektronenpaaren zwischen Atomen

questions.notes: Wikipedia: the term ‘covalence’ was first used by Irving Langmuir in 1919; the idea goes back to Lewis in 1916.

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is the only bone in the human body that is NOT attached to another bone?
A. Ear bone B. Skull C. Hyoid
Answer: C. The hyoid bone, located in the throat, is the only bone in the human body that is not attached to another bone. It supports the tongue and is involved in swallowing.
questions.de: Welcher ist der einzige Knochen im menschlichen Körper, der mit keinem anderen Knochen verbunden ist?
questions.en: What is the only bone in the human body that is not connected to any other bone?

timeline.labelEn: The Kebara 2 Neanderthal skeleton is found in Israel, with the first Neanderthal hyoid bone
timeline.labelDe: In Israel wird das Neandertaler-Skelett Kebara 2 gefunden, mit dem ersten Zungenbein eines Neandertalers

questions.notes: Wikipedia: the hyoid is only distantly articulated to other bones by muscles or ligaments. Timeline from Wikipedia’s Kebara Cave article.
